title: F05: Receipt pipeline: upload, background extraction, persist, failure handling
milestone: M3 Extraction pipeline
labels: backend, ai
---
## Goal
Upload a receipt, extract it in the background, persist the result and handle every failure path.

**Depends on:** F03, F04
**Built by:** `backend-dev`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Tables `receipts`, `expenses` and `line_items` with repositories, as in `backend/persistence.md`
- [ ] All `/receipts` routes, and `GET /expenses`, `POST /expenses` (including manual entry for a failed receipt) and `GET /expenses/{id}`, replace their stubs; the `POST /expenses` stub label and `test_contract.py` move from F06 to F05
- [ ] The OpenAPI spec is unchanged (drift check passes)
- [ ] Every row of the failure-handling table in `backend/ai-extraction.md` has an API test
- [ ] Every transition in `contracts/receipt-lifecycle.md` has an API test, including the startup reset to `interrupted`, retry `409`s and delete during extraction
- [ ] One extraction at a time (lock taken before `uploaded` → `extracting`); no DB session open during the model call
- [ ] The plausibility rule fails implausible output with `not_a_receipt`; `assess` sets flags and review status with an injectable `today`
- [ ] `merchant` is stored after `domain.redaction.clean_merchant`, and line-item descriptions and `raw_model_output` after `redact_text` (decision 0017), with tests
- [x] Decided: the stored raw output gets its `merchant` replaced by the `clean_merchant` result when it parses as JSON (0017 amendment)
- [ ] Logs from `app.services` use fixed templates only (AST test), and no recorded case's distinctive values appear in any log record
- [ ] Line items go through the `ItemCategorizer` seam; the F05 placeholder leaves them `uncategorized` until F07
